title: Assist request
description: Everything that is about to leave the process, and nothing else. This object IS the egress boundary: if it is not in here it does not go, and the receipt hashes exactly this. Built only by AssistContract.buildRequest, which enforces the allowlist — never hand-constructed.

intent.description: A closed set. An open 'prompt' field would make the boundary unauditable, because nobody could say afterwards what the assistant was asked to do.

requestedBy.description: Which module asked. Carried from emergence's LLM_CONTRACT: no untraceable calls.

reason.description: Human-readable why. Shown to the person before sending.

content.description: The only text that leaves. Each item was explicitly handed over; nothing here was read from the vault or swept from the lattice.

field.description: Which allowlisted field this came from.

nodeId.description: Local reference only. Never sent — stripped before transport, kept for mapping the response back.

provider.description: Local first. Cloud is never the default path.
